Hi Emily / Carlos —

Thanks again for the productive discovery call this morning. I pulled together a concise POC plan and a one-page success checklist so your team can validate whether Redwood meets Atlas Health's latency, cost, and security needs during a 3-week trial. Attachment: POC-success-checklist.xlsx (outline below).

Quick summary of proposed plan (high level):
- Goal: Validate 5 production-like flows (patient intake, anonymized notes summarization, triage prompts, batch-embedding of 50k records, and reranking) with end-to-end latency and cost metrics.
- Duration: 3 weeks (week 0 setup/kickoff, week 1 functional run, week 2 load/latency tests + quality evals, week 3 wrap/hand-off).
- Primary success criteria (need your confirmation):
  1) 95th percentile gen latency <= 450ms for single-shot prompts (avg seq ~120 tokens).
  2) Batch embedding throughput >= 10k embeddings/hour with quantized model profile.
  3) No P0 security gaps in the checklist (network, KMS, audit logs).
  4) Qualitative: average prompt pass-rate on your 15 eval prompts >= 90%.

Proposed RACI / owners (draft):
- A (Accountable): Emily Chen (Atlas Health) — overall POC sign-off.
- R (Responsible): Dev Patel (Redwood) — infra/setup, VPC peering, model config.
- C (Consulted): Marissa Cole (Redwood CS) — evaluation metrics, runbooks.
- I (Informed): Procurement team (procurement@atlashealth.com) — contract/PO coordination.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Confirm owners above or provide alternate names (reply-all).
2) Procurement contact to share any specific PO or MSA requirements.
3) Security contact at Atlas to review network/KMS items (we can loop in a quick tech-huddle).
4) If agreed, propose kickoff Wednesday 2026-05-25 09:00 PT for a 45-min tech and admin sync.

Attachments in this email: POC-success-checklist.xlsx (one-pager with eval plan and acceptance criteria).

Thanks — I kept this tight so we can iterate quickly.

Best,

Forwarding the plan to provide the technical checklist / quick notes. Attachment: redwood-network-reqs.pdf (network + KMS checklist).

High-level tech notes:
- We support VPC peering or a secure VPN tunnel. For the POC, VPC peering is preferred (lower latency).
- Required firewall: allow outbound to 52.23.11.0/24 on ports 443, 8443; ephemeral ports for batching.
- KMS: we support Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) via AWS KMS; audit logs are available and can be retained 90 days (extendable).
- Data: all persisted artifacts for the POC are encrypted at rest. We recommend a separate test dataset with PHI redacted; if you need a quick redaction script we can provide one.
- Quick checklist for your infra team: VPC CIDR, contact window for peering (2 hours), NAT/route checks, list of IP allowlist entries (we'll provide).

I'll be available for the kickoff (05/25). If Atlas wants a short 30-min infra-only pre-kickoff we can schedule tomorrow 05/20 08:00 PT.
